the launcher carries the task into the Harness composer

focus returns to the pane instead of falling to <body>

provers.check: the NEEDS KEY action opens the providers panel

a created session appears in recent work

rows.proves: The execution policy is one option's own label, it moves the plan when it changes, and the approval card states the policy in force rather than a written-down copy of it.

provers.check: changing the policy moves the policy row
the card names the policy that is asking, and it is the policy in force

rows.proves: Both seats are chosen in the pane, named in the plan, and a change to either moves the row that states them.

provers.check: the models row names the lead and the critic
changing the critic moves the models row

rows.proves: Events arrive over the stream without a reload, each draws a card, and Replay re-reads the log from its retained floor without duplicating an event.

Replay re-reads the log from its first retained event and rebuilds the view from it

rows.proves: An approval is one card naming the tool, the arguments, the policy, the capability and the expiry; the decision is posted with the session that owns it and records exactly what the pane said it would.

provers.check: an approval arrives as one card that names the tool and shows the arguments
the decision is posted with the session that owns the approval

provers.check: the diff dialog counts the change and says it is not frozen at a verdict
the change is counted per file from the same diff the server reports

rows.proves: Applying a diff still refuses the cases it always refused - uncommitted user changes, a quarantined workspace, an unjoined child, an unresolved effect - and still reports the refusal.

provers.check: checking the worktree box says so in the directory row

provers.check: the row reads the event in words instead of its field names

rows.capability: Council Hall session spawning and chronicle browsing

rows.capability: Four-stage orchestrator with architect/coder role selection

the reasoning control reaches the two seats the route gives it to, and the other two say off

rows.proves: Two or more models still run against one question, each panel keeps its own reply and status, and every figure shown is the figure the response carried.

every figure on screen is the figure the response carried for that reply
Revisit restores separate opinions and synthesis without rerunning or changing the server copy

rows.proves: The selected model and persona are what the pane says they are: with no model Send is off and says why, and with one the response mode is named beside it.

provers.check: with no model the Send button is off and says why
empty conversation and labelled response mode

rows.proves: A message is answered by a labelled turn carrying its model and usage, the transcript is not read aloud on every token, and the context each answer was sent with is printed.

the transcript is a log that does not read itself aloud on every token
every answer prints the context it was sent, composed by the pane's own helper
